verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI provides explicit batch/async crawling features: arun_many-style multi-URL configuration, parallel crawling, deep-crawl with resume_state/checkpoint recovery for long-running jobs, retry with proxy chains, and a Dockerized API server for scaled deployment—directly matching batch scraping thousands of URLs asynchronously. Community feedback notes production concerns (rate limiting, bot mitigation) that a data engineer must handle themselves, tempering full confidence.
